title: Procedural Preview Infinite World
description: Extract brep kernel into @geometry/brep/js, setup @procedural/react flow-based brep editor with R3F viewport, and @procedural/play playground.
summary: Fixed scroll-wheel zoom in procedural 3D preview. Root cause: preview pane used panel window body (overflow-auto) so wheel scrolled the shell instead of reaching OrbitControls. Switched preview to buildPuzzle3dWindowBody + registerUiPuzzle3dSurfaceHost for canvas layout. Also pinned OrbitControls to gl.domElement and added passive:false wheel guard on WorldCanvas root so zoom is not stolen by scrollable ancestors.
